ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpersonal ENVIRONMENT be able to;.

3. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about PRACTICES.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on PRACTICES.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to PRACTICES.

5. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for PRACTICES be able to;? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for PRACTICES be able to;.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for PRACTICES be able to;.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying People found at home? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for People found at home.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on People found at home.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to People found at home.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about People found at home.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care PRACTICES.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care PRACTICES.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Care PRACTICES.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Our ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our ENVIRONMENT.

10. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

11. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Glucose and oxygen

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Our Home? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Our Home.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Our Home.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Our Home.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Our Home.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Dressing ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Care PRACTICES and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Care for PRACTICES be able to; and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
